content: Dormant Plan 9-family trees bit-rot in the host bootstrap layer first: Harvey's build depended on an EOL Ubuntu 21.10 Docker base (apt mirrors moved), a GitHub-release 9legacy.iso on an archived org, and an expect+qemu prompt-matching harness. In-tree generators (yacc/lex output, compile-and-run tools like awk/maketab and jpg/rgbycc) assume a self-hosting Plan 9 environment and break under cross/Unix-hosted builds. 9legacy survives as a curated patch queue; plan9port is the living host-tool layer.
